purpose: 展示等值异序输入、重复计算、深层隔离、大额精度及有实际发生额的零净额科目方向。
用两个公开入口展示同一多问题输入的确定首个叶子异常及失败后输入不变。

structure-before-business: normalize=VoucherFormatError post=VoucherFormatError input_unchanged=true
duplicate-before-currency: normalize=DuplicateVoucherError post=DuplicateVoucherError input_unchanged=true
currency-before-entries: normalize=UnsupportedCurrencyError post=UnsupportedCurrencyError input_unchanged=true
exact-account-before-amount: normalize=UnknownAccountError post=UnknownAccountError input_unchanged=true
inactive-before-amount: normalize=InactiveAccountError post=InactiveAccountError input_unchanged=true
amount-before-later-entry: normalize=InvalidEntryAmountError post=InvalidEntryAmountError input_unchanged=true
balance-after-valid-entries: normalize=UnbalancedVoucherError post=UnbalancedVoucherError input_unchanged=true
